points.reason: The process samples enable_i into en at line 129, and en controls whether cnt advances or is cleared at lines 130-134, so the setting can be modified or disabled to corrupt or stop clock generation.
cnt and cnt2 feed the pulse decode, while en can stop cnt and clk_i or rstn_i can stall or clear the divider, allowing the generated schedule to be corrupted or withheld.
The concurrent assignments compute every clk_en_o pulse from cnt and cnt2, so corruption of the decode inputs or assignments can produce incorrect or missing downstream enable events.
